patch_description: The current approach uses a purely linear direct-demand reward and a two-hop reward scaled by 0.12 and discounted by transit-node load; the degree penalty weight is 1.0. This version changes only the direct-link reward: it blends 90% normalized demand with 10% of its square root. The small concave component gives moderate-demand links a little more influence without displacing the strongest direct-demand signal. The two-hop formulation and penalty weight remain unchanged, so this is a focused comparison rather than a wholesale retuning.
